argument: The refusal has to be legible in the attachment route and the body's weight, not only in the copper witness at its origin.
The settled silhouette is compelling and the three copper limbs read as a material counter-rhythm, but a caption-free comparison still has to name the same detour before and after deletion.
The field, Enter/Space, and named buttons all reach the same refusal rule; removing the latest refusal must continue to expose a changed state without browser history.
The orange route is an easy signal. Keep v003 held unless the pale body still feels displaced when the witness marks are hidden, and delete it if the detour is only a decorative overlay.
